What stays open -- following the engine's settled order, following an explicit order again after a refusal -- widens what the shadow follows and does not change the trajectories to be reviewed. If the faculty holds that 'stop the infusion' must be followed before any human review, B is the reading: that judgment is theirs, and it is the first open decision
